chosokabe.status: Staged 15 distinct named officers; not part of production. D27 resolves only Kunichika's V8 chronology conflict. Other integration gates remain unverified.
chosokabe.scope: Chosokabe only;15 total records include futurebirth/deferredservice, not15 active1560 soldiers
chosokabe.sourceBoundaries: Official municipal/prefectural pages verify only stated identities/activity. Otepia catalogue is discovery-only, not lifespan or1560 service evidence. Dictionaries are scholarly secondary; Secondary source keys are independent modern research, not official primary sources. All unknown dates and gameplay values are explicitly authored.
chosokabe.affiliationBoundaries: All gameplay placements aggregate into the single prescribed Oko castle. No claim every retainer resided there or served Kunichika in1560. Deferred adult Tani/Chikanao avoid asserting earlier service; juvenile/futurebirth records are not eligible at start.

activationDecisions.reason: D27 preserves deathYear 1560. The municipal chronology places Kunichika's death after Motochika's May 1560 battle, so he remains alive at scenario start.
activationDecisions.scope: V8 permits only s1560 Kunichika as Chosokabe leader and Oko lord, with matching clan, home and location. Metadata does not grant this exception.
activationDecisions.runtimeBoundary: D27 does not change death scheduling, succession, randomness or save mechanics. It does not add an exact June death event or approve production activation.

identityExclusions.reason: Dictionary annotation tentatively identifies YoshidaTakayori with Shuko; one record only, not a distinct quota filler.

sourceClasses.onoBiography: institutional edited history with genealogy caveats

iyo.sourceBoundaries: Institutional identity or dated activity does not establish an exact lifespan or continuous1560 service. Authored numeric lifespans are explicit estimates; source-qualified dates retain their stated documentary or genealogical limits. No unsupported earlier namesakes are imported.
iyo.placementBoundaries: Yuzuki and Kurose are scenario aggregation stations, not claims that every local lord resided there. Kurushima is used for its naval lord. Local independent houses are represented under Kono/Saionji for playability, not assertions of absolute vassalage. Attributes, ranks and traits are manually authored design values. Deferred debut is a conservative presentation boundary, not a proven genpuku date.
iyo.kinBoundary: All14 isKin=false values conservatively decline an unproven direct relationship to the current clan leader. This is not a historical assertion that each person was unrelated. Ono father's/brother's identity is disputed; Kono late succession genealogy is disputed; Saionji Kinhiro's adoption/biological relationship is not elevated from a secondary account to proven kin.
excludedIdentities: Earlier Kono Michinobu (刑部大輔), died1519; distinct from canonical 左京大夫 Michinobu.
Ono Toshinao, retired1553; not padded as an active1560 officer.
Murakami Takeyoshi, already in the Mori/Chugoku roster; no duplicate.
Doi Kiyoyoshi, born1546 and absent in Tosa until1562; not padded as an active1560 retainer.
Hoketsu Akinobu is not independently duplicated or equated with Sakinobu; the institutional source explicitly leaves their identity uncertain.

ichijo.scope: Eight prescribed or municipally named Ichijo identities; no deceased predecessors or juvenile quota filler
ichijo.sourceBoundaries: Institutional secondary histories, including retrospective chronicle accounts, not independent contemporary verification of all names or lifespan years. All stats/ranks/traits are scenario design; no story-derived negative trait.
ichijo.affiliationBoundaries: 1560 service at Nakamura is an explicit prescribed one-castle scenario aggregation. Later1573/1574 activity does not establish1560 direct service or garrison placement.
identityExclusions: No juvenile Naomasa or other future child used to pad the active roster
No inferred kin for the uncertain guardian; no fabricated personal names behind honorifics
